# World Population Review

> > Comprehensive global population statistics, demographics, and country rankings covering nations, cities, continents, and international organizations.

World Population Review provides data-driven insights into population trends, economic indicators, and demographic profiles for countries worldwide. The site features detailed rankings of international organizations like the European Union and G7, population statistics for major regions including North America, Europe, and Asia, and city-level demographic data for nations such as Pakistan, China, and India.

## Key Topics

- European Union
- Demographics
- Population Statistics
- Country Rankings
- Germany
- France
- Italy
- China
- India
- G7 Countries
- International Organizations
- Eurozone
- Advanced Economies
- Emerging Markets
- Continental Population Data

## Global Population Overview

- [Population by Continent 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/continents): Global population statistics by continent with area and demographic data

## International Organizations & Economic Groups

- [List of Countries in the European Union 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/country-rankings/european-union-countries): EU member countries list with population data for Germany, France, Italy, Spain
- [G7 Countries 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/country-rankings/g7-countries): G7 member nations ranking with GDP statistics and economic data
- [Newly Industrialized Countries 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/country-rankings/newly-industrialized-countries): Emerging economies ranking with GDP data for Turkey, Malaysia, China, Mexico

## Cities & Regional Population Data

- [Pakistan Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/pakistan): Pakistan cities ranked by population including Karachi, Lahore, Faisalabad

## Country & Territory Profiles

- [Puerto Rico Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/puerto-rico): Puerto Rico population statistics and demographic profile with San Juan data
